claims.sourceText: CRS, 'U.S. Intelligence Community (IC): Appointment Dates and Appointment Legal Provisions for Selected IC Leadership', IF10538 version 6, updated 19 March 2019, Table 1, https://www.congress.gov/crs_external_products/IF/PDF/IF10538/IF10538.6.pdf
claims.text: The Congressional Research Service's intelligence-community leadership roster records the office and the date as 'Director of the National Reconnaissance Office (D/NRO) Betty J. Sapp (sworn in July 6, 2012)', and gives Christopher Scolese as 'nominated, February 7, 2019' in the same row.

The same table gives the appointment authority for the post she held: '50 U.S.C. 3041(b)(2)(B) DOD Secretary needs DNI to concur with the recommendation to the President; and 50 U.S.C. 3602(a)(2), Director is appointment by the President, Senate confirmed; then pursuant to S.Res. 470, Senate confirmed (SSCI and SASC).'

edges.label: Director of the National Reconnaissance Office, sworn in 6 July 2012
edges.note: Director of the National Reconnaissance Office, sworn in 6 July 2012, per the CRS intelligence-community leadership roster of 19 March 2019.

b.label: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

edges.label: The DNI must concur in the appointment to the office she held
edges.note: The statutory route to the office she held requires the Director of National Intelligence to concur in the Secretary of Defense's recommendation to the President, per 50 U.S.C. 3041(b)(2)(B) as cited in the same CRS table.
